apps.name: GlassType
apps.localizedDescription: An offline iOS keyboard with English, Russian and Ukrainian layouts, local suggestions, glide typing, searchable emoji and configurable Liquid Glass styling. Beta software; installation and keyboard behavior should be tested on-device.

versions.localizedDescription: Beta build 76. Backspace deletes on touch-down, begins repeating after 300 ms, and accelerates during a hold. Haptic and visual press feedback start immediately. Unsigned IPA for SideStore testing.
Beta build 71. Fixes visible soft highlighting for fast taps on edge keys and adds configurable glide-trail fade duration and thickness. Unsigned IPA for SideStore testing.
Beta build 67. Adds immediate soft key-press highlighting across all layouts, pooled key previews, and an accelerating backspace engine. Unsigned IPA for SideStore testing.
Beta build 50. Adds asynchronous, cancellable glide decoding with throttled touch sampling and memory-mapped lexicon support. Unsigned IPA for SideStore testing.
Beta build 46. Replaces eager dictionary parsing with mapped UTF-8 binary tries for English, Russian and Ukrainian. Unsigned IPA for SideStore testing.
Beta build 42. Makes next-word suggestions selectable, expands the English and Russian offline lexicons to about 48,000 word forms, and adds automatic spacing after punctuation.
Beta build 39. Refines key-row alignment, adjustable keyboard sizing, glide input and local prediction. Unsigned IPA for SideStore testing.
Beta build 34. Adds refined spacebar cursor movement and includes the current keyboard, emoji, touch and language features for device testing.
